title: fix(mail): log DB errors on token verify instead of silent 401
description: mail/src/server.rs auth middleware catches Err(e) from token_store.verify in the same wildcard arm as Ok(None), silently returning 401 with no log. Operators see auth failures with no indication that the DB is broken. Fix: separate Ok(None) and Err(e) arms; log tracing::error! on DB failure.
